Messages.Author: kpram
Messages.Body:
As a  action, this vampire enters combat with a ready vampire. If that minion is ready after the combat ends, untap the acting vampire.

The intent here is to allow fight decks to remove beads from the table without ruining the game of the target. It is on par with Bum's Rush, but with the bonus of allowing an untap if you don't torporize the annoying deflector, you just empty him. Stop your prey from bloating on minion tap by knocking the beads off, but still keep some pressure on your grand-prey.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: It is not a new card you need, it is better players  This would give every rush deck another answer to combat defense.
